note: PanelUI is a React Native / Expo library (reanimated, expo-blur, uniwind). Its source cannot run in Cupric’s DOM renderer, so the catalogue is vendored as reference + prompt material, not as code. Behaviour and copy are what we mine; the React Native implementation stays upstream.
